boundary_result.reason_summary: The target occurrence "剌史" appears in the Liu Xiaobiao annotation text "年十八剌史周俊..." where it functions as an office title (刺史) modifying/identifying 周俊 (Zhou Jun). The occurrence is part of a biographical description stating that at age eighteen, [someone] was appointed by 刺史周俊. The office title "剌史" here is used referentially to identify Zhou Jun by his office — it does not itself denote an entity participating in a narrated event at this occurrence. The office title is a descriptive label attached to the person Zhou Jun, who is the actual participant in the event of appointing. The title itself merely identifies/qualifies the person rather than being an entity engaged in an event.
